snippet.title: Jupiter Hell Classic - Early Access Launch Date Trailer
snippet.description:
Jupiter Hell Classic is an old-school beast - a tactical, turn-based roguelike forged from the legacy of DRL and reborn into the Jupiter Hell universe.
It brings back the core combat you know from Jupiter Hell - raw, unfiltered, and twice as merciless - but with a few new moves you'll want to test for yourself.

Turn-based combat. Permadeath. 
No handholding. No fillers.
Just raw gameplay, your skill, and guns that don’t need fancy skins to get the job done.

Wishlist now and prepare:
 https://store.steampowered.com/app/3126530/Jupiter_Hell_Classic/

The Early Access launch is packed with content and systems ready to dive into:
- 4 episodes, 6 branching paths, 9 special levels, and 2 boss fights
- Dozens of procedural generators, event types, and generation sets
- 3 core classes, 15 Master Traits (sub-classes), and 24 regular traits
- 25 enemy types and 100+ items, including rare exotics and uniques
- 30 weapon and armor assembly recipes for on-the-fly crafting
- 5 difficulty levels, 16 challenge modes, and support for dual challenges
- Hundreds of badges and achievements to chase

Space hell opens August 13. Bring extra medkits. 💀



------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Developer: ChaosForge
Publisher: Hyperstrange
